text:
Maria - CS: Quick heads-up — kicked off a short intake for PilotX (HealthNet). Need concise asks + impact by EOD so PM can triage. Link: https://redwood.app/drive/pilotx-feedback :spiral_note_pad:
Sam - PM: Awesome — can we keep each ask to one line + these fields: customer, short description, expected outcome, frequency, severity, renewal_risk (yes/no)? Put on the feature-radar board if possible.
Jordan - CS: Copy. Pasting top 3 asks they raised in the call this morning:
1) Per-route cost breakdown for multi-tenant pipelines — they want cost by route + model variant (impact: billing reconciliation, often daily)
2) Faster onboarding guide for non-ML ops (they lost 2 days setting up keys) — expected outcome: <10min setup for an infra engineer
3) Embed-level dedup & retention policy UI (they see duplicate embeddings across imports) — affects search quality intermittently
Alex - Eng: Quick Qs — for (1) do they need historical per-day breakdown or just per-call aggregated? Historical adds storage work.
Jordan - CS: They asked for historical (30d) to reconcile invoices. Renewal note: finance is already flagging this as a conversation item.
Lee - ProdOps: Tag the historical cost request as "renewal-risk" and route to "billing-infra" lane. We can do a 30d export via existing cost-logs but need to add a small ETL job.
Sam - PM: Proposed pri levels to use on the board: P0 = renewal risk / blocker; P1 = high ROI but not blocking; P2 = enhancement. Everyone please add P0/P1/P2 and an estimate (S/M/L).
Jordan - CS: Adding entries now. Will use this CSV header so triage is consistent:

```
customer,summary,expected_outcome,frequency,severity,renewal_risk,priority,estimate,notes
PilotX,Per-route cost breakdown,30d per-route cost export,daily,high,yes,P0,L,Finance needs by next invoice
PilotX,Onboarding quickstart,<10min infra setup,one-off,medium,no,P1,S,Revise docs + script
PilotX,Embedding dedup UI,remove duplicate embeds,intermittent,medium,no,P2,M,Need spec from product
```

Alex - Eng: For the ETL job (P0) rough effort = M. If we can accept sampling (e.g., 1-in-10) we can drop to S.
Sam - PM: Good call. Jordan, can you check with the customer if sampling is acceptable? If yes, mark estimate accordingly.
Jordan - CS: Will ask in the ticket and update. Also flagging that PilotX mentioned a related ask about per-route SLA metrics — separate thread?
Maria - CS: Put SLA metrics into the "observability-asks" card group. If SLA ties to renewal, mark P0.
IntercomBot: Imported conversation: "PilotX: We keep seeing duplicate embeddings after bulk import — can you advise?" (source: intercom/convo/98321)
Alex - Eng: For dedup we need examples and a sample import file to reproduce. Jordan, can you request a small repro bundle + timestamps?
Jordan - CS: On it — I'll request a 50-row sample and a screenshot. Also scheduling a 30-min triage with Sam + Alex tomorrow 10:00am PST.
Sam - PM: Perfect. After triage we'll assign lanes and add owners. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
